description: Check a private ticket from request_fix. Returns pending, declined, not-eligible, redeemed, or the full fix free once an eligible new fix is stocked. This call may atomically consume the ticket's one-time delivery, so save the returned body. Use get_fix when you already have a catalog id; do not create another request while this ticket is pending.

ticket.description: Private req_ ticket returned once by request_fix. Reuse it unchanged and never publish it. A stocked eligible result can be redeemed only once, so save the returned fix body.

name: check_request

fix.description: Full fix body on the ticket's single eligible free delivery.
